text:
maria: Quick starlight theme pass — quick poll: keep the bluish code accent or shift to teal for better contrast in charts? Screenshot in thread.
ash: Teal for code tokens. Blue is colliding with link color in the side nav, makes inline diffs confusing.
jin: Agree on teal. Also axis lines at 12% opacity disappear on OLED — suggest to increase to 30% or use a 1px hairline (#ffffff at 12% is almost invisible).
sam: Accessibility note: code token text needs to meet 4.5:1 against the code-bg. Can we run contrast checks before finalizing accents?
maria: Will run automated checks. Proposing variables: `--bg-900: #0b0f14`, `--code-bg: #0f1318`, `--code-accent: #2ac7b8` (teal), `--link: #4aa3ff`. Example:
```
:root {
  --bg-900: #0b0f14;
  --panel-800: #0f1318;
  --code-accent: #2ac7b8;
  --muted-comment: #6b7280;
}
```
ash: Teal looks good. Heatmap gradient needs smoothing though — current stops feel banded. Current: `#001219 -> #0f4c75 -> #2ac7b8`.
jin: For charts I'd prefer a single-hue ramp plus a desaturated neutral for labels. Keeps visual weight consistent across dashboards.
theme-bot: accessibility report: `starlight-syntax` commentTokens fail AA small text (ratio ~3.8:1).
maria: Ack. If we bump comment color to `#7a7f87` or `#8b9096` it should hit AA, but need visual pass.
sam: UX nit: the toggle pill for "Dark / Light" in the console is too close to card bg — affordance is weak. Either add a 1px highlight border or a subtle 6px shadow.
ash: Caveat: multiple shadows across list items hurt paint; for long lists (200+ rows) we should avoid heavy box-shadow. Prefer `border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)` where supported.
jin: Also, the sparklines on the model route table use the same blue as links — collisions again. Use `--sparkline-accent: rgba(42,199,184,0.9)` and reduce stroke width to 1.2px.
maria: Action list: (1) I'll run contrast matrix and post results, (2) ash to prototype chart palettes with smoother ramps, (3) jin to run perf paint tests on list rendering with borders vs shadows, (4) sam to tweak copy for the theme switcher affordance. Anyone object?
sam: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
ash: No objections. I'll push a quick prototype to the design branch later today.
jin: I'll run the 1k-row perf test and post flamegraph.
maria: I'll post contrast matrix + preferred HEXs and a short Loom with before/after.
theme-bot: scheduled task: `contrast-checker/starlight-syntax` queued — will reply with full matrix when done.
maria: Thanks all — will follow up in this thread with results. :sparkles:
